batting.dismissal: c AS Joseph b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: SN Khan
batting.dismissal: c J Little b Rashid Khan

batting.name: RR Rossouw
batting.dismissal: c R Tewatia b AS Joseph

batting.name: AR Patel
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: Aman Hakim Khan
batting.dismissal: c HH Pandya b Rashid Khan

batting.name: HH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c Abishek Porel b KK Ahmed

balls.text: Swatted straight back over mid-off and Delhi have breached 160! Hard-length again from Shami as Nortje runs down the track, gives himself room and slams it.
Short, pacy delivery on off. He backs away, looking for a cut. Misses

On a length outside off and Axar hits it straight to David Miller at deep cover. Was in Axar's slot, but he was a touch legside and slightly off-balanced when looking to cream that away. Does not get enough connection and Miller gobbles it up.
Gives himself room as Shami bowls this slower on leg. He muscles it straight down the ground to long on
Back of a length ball on the hips of Axar who pulls it to deep square leg. No run taken.
Short and wide, and Axar hammers it over wide long-on.  That was asking to be it and Axar obliged.
Slightly short on middle and spinning onto leg as Axar hacks the pull to the right of Tewatia who runs across from deep backward square leg. They only take a run. Axar wants to keep strike.
Runs down the track first ball, gets a thick inside edge past the bowler for a run

Nope, not happening twice, says Rashid! Legbreak with a hint of over-spin on the ball. Was just on and around off. He looks for a slog sweep second time around, gets a massive top-edge as the ball goes straight up. Pandya completes a catch at extra cover.
Gets holds of the slog sweep and absolutely clobbers Rashid over deep square leg. In the slot on middle and leg, he clears his front leg and gets a six
Another legbreak and this one grips and turns. He can only slice to point
Legspinner on middle, he looks for a mighty slog, drags it to deep midwicket. Wants two, not on.
In the slot on middle, he gives himself room and gets a good piece on the flourishing cover drive but hits it straight to extra cover.
Back of a length ball on the hips of Axar as he works it to deep fine leg.
Going, going, gone! Right in Axar's wheel-house outside off. He extends his arms and lofts Little over mid-off and eventually over the ropes.
Good length ball outside off, he gives himself room and pushes towards cover. The fielder has a shy at the stumps, misses and a run is conceded via an overthrow,
Banged in short again, outside off. He backs away, looking to ramp it, but misses.
Banged in short on off, he hacks it to long on
Flatter and on the pads of the batter, who glances it to short fine leg.
Length on off, he goes back and punches it back to the bowler
On a length on the pads of Aman, who heaves it to Little at long leg
On a length outside off, gets it off the inside half of the blade towards the midwicket fielder

Goes for a sweep again, gets a top-edge and Little makes no mistake at deep backward square leg. Slightly slower through the air, outside off. He lines up for that sweep, but can only mistime it this time around. The ball goes high up and Little, I think misjudged the catch initially, but held on.
Length ball outside off, he reaches for it with the sweep and slams it in front of square for a four to deep midwicket.
Short of a good length ball outside off, he dabs it to point with an open face of the blade.
Back of a length ball on off, he drags it to deep midwicket. Loses his shape a touch there.
Banged in short on the hips of Axar, who helps it to deep backward square leg. There is a bit of a misfield, but no harm done.
Short and very wide, he throws his hands at it, get it off the cue end of the bat to deep third.
Banged in short, Sarfaraz eyes the pull but is a bit hurried by the pace. Clogs his pull over midwicket.
Ooh, looks to take him on right away. Was a length ball just outside off, he clears his front leg, looking to smash him straight over. Misses.
Oh, that's a shot-and-a-half! Axar has been in stunning form of late and he is showing his prowess here. In the slot for him on middle, and he crunches it over wide long on for a mammoth six.

Goes down on one knee and nails the sweep to deep backward square leg, where Little does well again diving to his left. Oops, Sarfaraz and Rashid have a collision with both players ball-watching. All okay, though
A touch slower now on off, he clips it to short midwicket
Another flattish length ball on off that is pushed to long off for a run
Flatter, shorter length ball on off. He goes low and slaps it towards long leg.
Legspinner outside off, he cuts it straight to backward point
Short, wide and Axar cuts it fiercely through covers for a scorching boundary. That will give him some confidence. End of an excellent spell from Joseph.
Another short of a length ball into the body of Axar, 140kph that. He plays that with soft hands towards short leg. Played that very well did Axar, getting nucely on top of the bounce.
Good length ball on the leg stump. Axar pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball on the hips of Axar, bowled at 148.3kph. The batter clips it to short leg.
Back of a length ball on off, was 145.3 kph, he looks to hoick it away, gets a thick inside-edge onto his pads with the ball going towards the on-side
Good length ball just outside off, patted to point.
Huge top-edge but falls safely. Full-length ball outside off, he sweeps it, gets a top-edge but the falls short of the incoming fielder from deep backward square leg.
Full-length ball outside off, he pushes it to mid-off.
Long-hop and duly punished. Just on off, as Axar goes back and pulls him past mid-on.
Flatter on middle, pushed back to the bowler

Takes two balls to create an impact! What a bowler, what a cricketer! Fuller, bowled at 94.3kph. Porel plays all around it, and sees his stumps in a mess. Was nowhere near it. Lost his balance, lost his footwork. Can't keep Rashid out of the game for too long.
Just a tad short on the pads of the batter who goes down on one knee and works it to deep backward square leg.
Nails the pull and slams Dayal over deep midwicket! Banged in short, but Dayal is not as quick. Porel gets into position nice and early and creams it up and over. Excellent hit.
On a length outside off, he pushes towards covers
On a length just outside off, he works it towards deep point with an open face
Length on middle and leg, he works it to deep square leg.

Dropped by Little running back form mid-on. In the slot for the batter, who looks to go too hard at it, ends up lofting it straight up. Little covers good ground but fails to hold on. Once he reached the ball, he would have liked to hang on, but Little at no point seemed comfortable under the catch.

On a length outside off, he pushes back to the bowler with a full face of the bat. The ball hits the bowler's boot and ricochets to Hardik, who has a shy at the stumps. Porel was struggling but would have made it.
Banged in short, he helps it to long leg.

That has hit him flush on the helmet. Porel wouldn't have faced such pace. Banged in short, with the line on point. The left-hander is late on the pull and the ball smacks into his helmet. The pyhsio is out to tend to him and the concussion test is on. Some concerning faces, but think Porel is fine. Yep, he is.

Oh, that would have been one of the catches of the tournament, but Dayal couldn't keep himself in. Short and wide, he slams the cut towards deep third, where Dayal plucks out a stunner with his right hand. But ends up trotting over the ropes.
Back of a length ball on the hips of Porel who works it to deep fine leg, where Little does so well once again diving full-length to his left.
Length on middle stump that is flayed away to deep backward square leg by Sarfaraz Khan.
On a length outside off, patted to point.
Another pull as Hardik goes short to Sarfaraz who pulls to long leg.
Goes short again to Porel, who swivel-pulls nicely to the right of deep backward square leg.
On a length on the pads of Sarfaraz who flicks it to deep midwicket.
Short, wide and Sarfaraz gets that important four. Does not cut it too hard, simply places it past point for a four.
Full-length ball just on and around off, as he pushes towards extra cover.
Back of a length ball outside off, he cuts it hard to deep point.

Banged in short and the ball thuds into Sarfaraz's helmet lobbing straight up. Saha races across the turf to catch the ball, that dropped just behind where short-leg would have been stationed. He drops it, but there was no bat on it. Concussion test on now. Serious pace from Joseph and Sarfaraz was late on the pull.
Back of  a length ball outside off, he opens the face of the bat through point
SO close to getting that hat-trick. Back of a length ball on the pads of Porel, who clips it uppishly towards mid-on, who just can't come in quick enough.

Oh, what a snorter of a delivery first up, and has Tewatia pulled off a blinder at point? Yes,s he has! Banged in short with the line shoulder-high. Rossouw was not expecting this first ball. Fends at it awkwardly with the ball going to point. Tewatia dives forward and seems to have picked put a beauty. The third umpire has been called for, and he deems that has carried clearly into Tewatia's hands. Joseph bowled that at 146kph and Rossouw had no answers.

Warner plays on and it's that angled bat that once again has brought about his downfall! On a length just outside off, was 145.5kph that delivery. He shapes for the cut, but the ball is quite close to him. Evetually, a thick inside-edge is all he gets that clatters into his stumps. Delight for Joseph, dismay for Warner.
On a length just outside off that is patted towards point.
Banged in short once more from Pandya, that is met by a fierce pull from Warner, but deep midwicket is in place.
Length on off, he pushes with softs hands towards deep midwicket, but they can only take a run.
On a length just outside off, he taps it to point.
Good length ball that tucks Warner up a touch. He works it away to deep midwicket for a run.
Another short of a length ball on the hips of Sarfaraz, who helps it towards deep backward square leg.
Back of a length just outside off, he pats it towards point and sets off, only to be sent back. He isn't impressed. Warner comes down to have word.

Goes fine, and that is some excellent work at the deep fine leg fence from Little. Length on the pads of Warner, who glances it fine, but Little puts in a full-length dive to his left and saves a few crucial runs.
Length on off, he pushes it to extra cover.
Top shot! Just a bit of width and that's all Waner wants. Short of a length ball outside off, he does not over-hit it, just places the cut to the right of point.
Fuller but the line is again down leg. Warner lets it go. Another wide.
Gets the length he was waiting for and cashes in. Fuller outside off, was right in Warner's arc and he just lofts it over mid-off. A couple of bounces and into the fence.
Still can't find the gaps, can Warner. Back of a length ball outside off, he pushes it to mid-off.
Back of a length ball to start off on off. Warner mistimes his punch to cover.
The extras counter continues to grow! Good length ball that was slanting down leg. Sarfaraz was looking for a glance, instead the ball hits his thigh pad and races away to the deep fine leg fence.
Back of a length ball on off stump. Sarfaraz clips it to midwicket.
Short of a good length outside off, he opens the face of the bat to scythe this one to deep point.
Length ball with a hint of shape outside off. He defends towards mid-off.
Short, but there isn't pace from the surface for Hardik. Sits up for Warner, who pulls it handsomely through square leg.
Gentle loosener to start off. Was a length ball on the pads of Sarfaraz as he works it to deep third.
Up and over! Length ball but there was room for Warner and he carves the ball over point to collect four more runs. This will give him much more confidence.
Full-length ball just outside off, he prods forward and pushes to covers.
Length outside off, he opens the face of the bat just a touch to get it down to deep third for a run.
Length ball with a lot of shape away from the batter, who lets the ball go

Cleans him up, and Shami has his second! Length ball with a bit of shape away from the batter. He looks to push through the off-side, without any foot movement and is caught on the crease. Can only manage a thick inside-edge as the ball rattles his off and middle poles.
Oh, SHOT! Marsh at his best. Good length ball just outside off, he punches through covers and finds the gap to perfection.

Oh, a high, high full toss that catches Warner by surprise. He looks to slog it away through the leg side, gets a thick outside edge as the ball hurries away to the deep third fence. Not called a no-ball and Warner has reviewed. That was just below the waist, so the on-field umpire's decision
Goes fuller this time around does Little, closer to the stumps. Warner pushes towards mid-off. No runs so far off this over.
The nip-backer again from the good length area that hits Warner's splice of the bat as he pats towards point.
On a length just on off. Warner gets across a touch and defends staunchly.
Back of a length ball outside off, he looks to shape for the cut but misses again.
Good length ball that jags back into Warner, who is beaten for pace as he looks to slaps that away towards the on-side. Gets hit on the thigh pad. Appeal for lbw but that was high.
Length that skids through on off as Marsh defends back towards the bowler.
Length ball with some swing but that was a quite a bit outside off. Marsh shoulders arms.

Short ball does the trick for Shami! Banged in short, and hurries Shaw, whose weight was forward. He still tries to got for the pull, but can only get a top-edge with the ball ballooning straight up for mid-on to take a comfortable catch.
Length that shapes back into Shaw, who looks to drive on the up, instead gets it off the inside-half of his bat through midwicket.
Length on middle and leg, he flicks to the left of short midwicket, who dives to his left and saves important runs for his team.
Short and enough width for Shaw to throw his hands at it. Gets a thick outside edge, but enough to clear deep  third.
Shami has not been able to control the swing today. On a length but strayed down leg, Saha dives to his left but can't rein it in.
Picks up a four now! Little gets that short and wide and Warner ain't missing out. Frees his arms and slams the cut past cover. Much more confident shot.
Good length ball with a bit of a nibble away from Warner. He opens the face of the blade and plays it late past point.
Cuts him into half again! Back of a length ball on middle, he shapes up for the pull, and then checks his shot to eventually miss it.
Some more swing, as the ball leaves the batter outside off. But that was a low full toss as Warner reaches for it and drives to covers, who misfields and concedes two runs.
Length ball that moves sharply back into Warner and catches him on the pads with the ball sliding down leg.
Short and wide to start off, he goes hard at it to get it to deep third, who collects it on the bounce.
Good length ball on off and middle, he tickles it to the on-side. End of an eventful over.
Five wides now. Sprays the length ball well down leg. Saha can't do anything there.
Just past the diving keeper! Length ball that nips back in, but the radar is down leg. Called four runs, but the ball seems to have hit his thigh pads. Warner won't mind.
Length ball just outside off, he comes down the track and then shoulders arms
Length that swings a lot outside of. He lets it go, and not called a wide.

Oh, cuts him into half!  Zips into the batter, who shuffles across, and is beaten all ends up. Saha moves to his right and collects. Gill is shouting for Pandya to take the review, Saha is not sure. The ball seems to have hit the batters trousers.
Length ball sprayed down leg, called a wide.

Loud, loud appeal for a caught behind, but the umpire says no! There was some sound as the ball passed the bat. Did the ball hit the stumps? Oh, it did! What a ball from Shami. Length on off, shaping just a touch away from Warner, who pokes at it, and should have been a goner.
Good length ball with a bit of shape but way outside the tramline. Saha has to move to his left.
Length ball around off, he works it away through forward square leg and sprints back for two to seal a six-wicket win!
Full on middle and leg, clips it away through midwicket to keep strike.
Full on leg, flicked away through square leg.
Full on off and middle, flicked it through midwicket for a couple.
On middle and legm whipped to deep square leg.
Pure timing from Miller. Full and outside off, he leans into it and hits it uppishly past cover. No stoipping that in the deep.
Very full and down leg, he misses the flick.
Length ball outside off, chops it to backward point.
Hugeeee! That is massive! Nortje bangs it in and angles it in. Sudharsan swivels and deposits well over fine leg. Batting exhibition.
Full and outside off, patted in front of point for a quick one.
Full on off, worked away through mid-on.

Gets to a half-century in style! How impressive has B Sai Sudharsan been tonight. Back of a length just outside off, he hops and ramps it over the wicketkeeper. Almost went the distance. Jussssst bounces in front of the boundary cushion.
Length ball outside off, he glides it to deep third.
Length ball angling away, punched wide of mid-off.
And this is hammered alright! Full and outside off, Miller gets the desired width. Thrashes it through covers to get the equation down to 26 off 24.

Second six of the over and the ball boy puts it down! Full and outside off, Miller fetches it and heaves it well over the on side. Mid-on was in the ring and it was only about clearing him. He clears the boundary.
Bowls it very wide outside off, Miller lets it be. Wide given.
Miller's arc and it is out of here! Back of a length outside off, he hangs back and heaves it well over deep midwicket.
Low full toss on off, heaved away on the bounce to long-on.
Length ball outside off, he hangs back and slaps it through cover.
Bowls it full outside off, he clears the front leg an d smacks it to long-on.
Shortish, he goes back and pulls it from outside off and through mid-on.
Flatter and down leg, he misses his sweep.
Flatter on off, he goes back and slaps it through cover.
Lands it on a length and it is the traditional legbreak, goes back and tucks it through square leg.
Another googly on a length, Sudharsan doesn't really pick it well. Goes back to cut and chops it to the off side.
Flatter and quicker on leg, he goes back and works it away through midwicket.

Has Kuldeep got his man? The umpire think so and Miller reviews. It is flighted and lands it full around middle and leg. It is the googly, too. Miller plays for the traditional legbreak and misses it completely. Is it sliding down leg though? Only that can save Miller. Ball-tracker shows that it would have missed the stumps.
Fullish and outside off, he goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge to deep third.
On the pads again, worked away through square leg.
Length ball outside off, he slaps it through cover. Mukesh slides and prevents the four, keeping them to two.
Angles it in on a length on off and middle, he tucks it to fine leg.

Hugeeee appeal, the umpire stays unmoved again! Marsh cannot believe it and asks Warmer to review it. It is the slower one bowled full on middle and leg, Vijay is done in by the lack of pace and is early into his flick and misses the ball. Is hit what seems to be adjacent. The ball tracker confirms the same - three reds!  The Arun Jaitley Stadium has just found its voice back.
Back of a length outside off, he glides it to deep third.
Length ball outside off, hangs back and slaps it to cover.
spears it full on off, perhaps he gets an inside edge onto his front leg. They rush through for one. Replay confirms the bat.
Fast and full length ball on off, he opens the face to get it through cover-point.
Fullish around off and middle pushed to mid-off.

Just out of Porel's diving reach! Bangs it short, Sudharsan just looks to direct it to the on side. Gets a top edge towards short fine leg. Porel covers a lot of ground and puts in the dive but it was out of his reach.
Full on off and middle, nudges it through midwicket for a brace.
back of a length angling in, pulls it through square leg. He wanted a second but was sent back early.
Length ball outside off, he gets behind it and punches it through cover.
Angles it on the pads, flicked through backward square leg for one.
Shortish on the stumps, he looks to pull but it lobs up off the pads to the on side.
Full and outside off, it is at 140.5 clicks. Vijay heaves it over cover for a couple.
Nails the pull! Short and outside off, angling in. Vijay swivels and pulls it all along the ground through backward square leg.
Full on middle and leg, pats it with soft hands towards long-on for one.
Excellently played. Back of a length outside off, Vijay hangs back and swats it over deep midwicket. One bounce and into the ropes.
Outside off, full as well, driven through cover-point for one.
Length ball outside off, punched to cover.
Shortish around off, he hops and pushes it to backward point.
Length ball outside off, he hangs back and punches it to deep cover.
Angles it down leg on a length, he misses the flick.
Full on middle and leg, pats it to the on side for a quick one.
Full on middle and leg, plays it with soft hands towards midwicket. Kuldeep himself gets to it and keeps it to one.
Lands it on a length on off, turns away. Sudharsan goes back and works it through midwicket.
Goes back, it is a touch short and low, hits it with the turn to deep square leg.
Smacked it alright! Very full and outside off, it is the traditional legbreak. Vijay clears his front leg and hits it over the bowler's head.
Floats it fullish and outside off, it is the wrong one. Vijay plays inside the line and gets beaten on the outside.
Back of a length outside off, he lets it be.
All timing that. Length ball outside off, it is the slower one. Sudharsan hops and slaps it through covers to beat sweeper to his left.
Length ball outside off, stays a touch low. Adjusts and punches it to long-off.
Short and outside off, he hops and slaps it to sweeper cover.
Full on the pads, worked away to fine leg.
Length ball on off, worked away towards square leg for one.
Fuller on middle, lunges and defends it towards cover.
Shortish on a length, again a googly on off. He hangs back and pulls it through midwicket.

Excellent catch from Porel! Umpire is unmoved and Capitals opt for the review immediately. It is a googly on a length outside off, Sudharsan hangs back and cuts. It is too close to that but he goes with it. Seems to be an inside edge. Oh no, UltraEdge is as flat as it can be. Sudharsan seemed to be quite confident and he is vindicated. Capitals lose their review.
Flatter and turning in from a length, he goes back and works it through midwicket for one.
Quicker and flatter around off, works it forward of square for one.
Slider full on leg, flicks it towards midwicket for one.
Full on middle and leg, flicked wide of midwicket for two. In fact, Rossouw misfields a touch.
Back of a length around off, he hangs back and opens the face to get it to point.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for two more.
Full on off, driven straight down to long-on. The fielder was wider and that allows them two.
Bowls it on a length on the pads, he flicks it through backward square leg for one.
Length ball outside off, he punches it through cover.

And Khaleel gets the big fish Pandya! This is what Capitals wanted from Khaleel and he has delivered. Lands it on a length and gets it to come back in to off. Pandya is forced to play at that and pushes at it a touch. Ends up getting a thick outside edge and Porel has his first catch in IPL cricket.
Length ball outside off, he hangs back and slaps it to sweeper cover.
Back of a length outside off, he hangs back and steers it to backward point.
Peach! Cuts Sudharsan into two halves. Lands it on a length and has it nip back in. Beats him on the inside.
Length ball outside off, glides it to backward point. Much better line and length that.
And he is greeted with a four! Full and on off, Sudharsan gets forward and flicks it through midwicket. No stopping that. 50 up for Titans.
Class! Overpitched outside off, it was the slower one at 121/6 kph. Hardik gets forward again and creams it through cover.
Full and outside off, gets forward and drives it to mid-off.
Banges in short and outside off, Sudharsan hops and looks to slash. It swerves in after it passes him and Porel fails to gather that. Given as runs but replays show that there was no edge.
Lands it shortish and angles it in, he tucks it towards square leg.
What a shot! Audacity at its very best. Fast and full at 144.2 kph on off. Sudharsan walks across and scoops it high and long over fine leg. Inventive strokeplay at its best.
Off the mark with a single. Back of a length outside off, he stands back and glides it towards short third to get going. 148.2 kph, but he has overstepped.

Jaffa! Nortje is well and truly making his presence in the IPL! It is a fireball at 148.8 kph. Gill, even in the excellent form that he is in, has no answer to that. It was speared in on a length around off, jags back in a touch. Gill was on the back foot and looks to defend but is beaten by the movement and is knocked over.
Fullish and outside off, driven to cover.
Angles it in on a length, he works it away forward or square on the on side for one.
Gill has missed out there. It was angled in on a length on the pads, he mishits his pull to short fine leg, Either side of that fielder and that would have been four.
Slower one around off,m on a length, he pats it to the on side and quickly gets to the other end. 114 clicks that.
Shot! Full and outside off, Sudharsan leans into it and nails the cover drive. Finds the gap between cover-point and covers.
Lands it on a length outside off, he looks to cut but it goes under the bat and on the bounce to the keeper.
Outside off on a length, punches it straight to covers.
Full and around off, pushes it towards mid-on for a quick one.
Misses out on the full toss! !47.9kph on the stumps, pushes it straight and hares to the other end before mid-on gets around.
Wrists, all wrists! Shortish around off, Gill stays on the back foot and just whips it past midwicket. What's worse, Nortje has overstepped.
Length ball in line of the stumps, defends it towards mid-on. Was a tad aerial.
Fullish and angling in, flicks it towards midwicket to get going.

Roaring start in IPL 2023 for Nortje! A 143 kph missile slanting in to Saha, cramps him for room and does him for pace. It is the nip-backer. Saha hops and looks to defend but gets beaten on the inside. The ball goes off his pads and disturbs the stumps. Titans lose their first.
Angles it in on a length on middle and leg, tucks it to midwicket. Not a bad start from Mukesh.
Good comeback. Lands it on a length on the sixth-stump line, has Gill poking at it and getting beaten.
Beauty! And Gill is no beast. This is all timing. Length ball outside off, he stands tall and just places it to the left of short cover. Pure timing, all elegance.
Fullish around off and middle, keeps it out to the on side.
Lands it on a length around off, no movement off the deck or in the air. Gill defends it back.
Gill is in SOME touch! That is on a length outside off, not too short, not too wide. Enough, though, for Gill to slap it through cover-point.

My word, has he struck it well! Length ball around off and middle, Saha picks the length early. Has it gone the distance? They are checking for that, looks to have cleared the ropes. Massive strike that, excellent start to the chase for Titans.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid-off.
And now Saha goes over mid-off! This is full and outside off, easy pickings. He clears his front leg and lofts it well over the fielder in the ring.
Oh pure timing! Length ball angling away, it was wide outside off. Saha stands tall and slaps it through cover-point. Not trying to hit it too hard.
Full and straight on off and middle, defends it towards point off the front foot.
Angling away on a length outside off, Saha has a slash but misses. Porel doesn't collect that cleanly.
